name: install-schema
summary: initialize_schema takes no lock of its own: no IRIS LOCK, no FOR UPDATE, no Python lock anywhere in its path (_engine/schema.py, schema.py, legacy.py, class_deploy.py, routine_record.py, schema_name.py, migrations/*); the footprint review says the same. It refuses inside a caller transaction and commits as it goes. No document restricts setup to one process; CHANGELOG.md:187-191 (4.7.0) treats two processes setting up one namespace as a supported case, and the REST server exposes it as POST /admin/schema/init (serialised only within one server process by module 16's _engine_lock). The locks setup reaches are other modules': the rebuild's parent ^IVG.AdjW shared (module 04, excludes no writer) and ^IVG.NKGBuild (module 10, serialises ^NKG builds only). The footprint's Adj.Degree and EnsureNKG locks are reached only through routine text setup creates, never at run time. PENDING-LIVE

inventory.what: caller-transaction refusal ($TLEVEL probe), not a lock
conn.commit() between setup phases; DML row locks held until the next commit

BuildKG: parent ^IVG.AdjW#"S":5 (module 04), excludes no row writer
read-modify-write of ^IVG.Deploy("routines"); kill/set of ^IVG.Deploy("fingerprint"); no lock
